patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are used for content sections, where a large image or visual element is balanced by a text block, often with significant negative space.

A large, elegant script font is used as a semi-transparent background visual element and for key section titles, creating a strong contrast with the clean, legible sans-serif for body text and subheadings.
The site uses a predominantly light, almost white background with dark text, accented by a vibrant orange for interactive elements and a palette of soft, muted pastels derived from the album artwork.
A large, semi-transparent script text element in the background parallaxes slowly, creating a sense of depth and continuity as the foreground content scrolls over it.
The hero section features a dynamic, circular arrangement of album art images that subtly rotates and shifts its perspective as the user scrolls down the page.

The 'complete works' section is presented as a clean, sortable list of releases with consistent metadata (date, type, duration), providing a structured and easily digestible overview of the artist's discography.

technique_notes: Implement a scroll-triggered animation system, likely using locomotive-scroll, to reveal content sections with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport, enhancing content discovery.

Create a large, semi-transparent script text element as a fixed or slow-parallax background layer, ensuring it remains visible and shifts subtly behind the main content as the user scrolls, using CSS transforms or a canvas element.

Design the hero's circular image arrangement using a combination of CSS transforms and potentially a canvas element for the dynamic rotation and perspective shift, triggered by scroll depth. Individual images within the arc should have subtle rounded corners.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant script display text (~4x body) for background and key titles, contrasted with large, bold sans-serif headings (~2x body) and a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and metadata.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (approx. 8-12px) are consistently applied to image containers and interactive elements like buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the hero and main content sections, creating a sense of calm and focus, with a more balanced density in the structured releases list.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its dynamic, circular hero element featuring album art that rotates with scroll, combined with a large, semi-transparent script text background that parallaxes slowly. This creates a unique sense of depth and visual storytelling that elevates it beyond a standard portfolio.
